findings.reason: Read failure, required removal failure and optional selection-hint failure have deliberately different outcomes. The remove case confirms the writing was restored before cleanup failed, then verifies a bounded retry. Capturing expectedData after crop is essential. Existing local crop/dimensions helpers avoid repeated mechanics. Further decomposition would pass a large mutable fixture between stages and weaken traceability.
